description: Random defect pattern with no spatial correlation (25 die failures, yield 93.9%). Defects uniformly distributed across wafer, consistent with baseline process variation. Particle level: 582/m³ (within specification <1000/m³). Equipment: LITHO_01, recipe RECIPE_04, slurry batch SB_2025_083. Process parameters nominal, yield within expected range for this process step.

Clustered defect pattern with 2-3 distinct particle clusters (114 total die failures, yield 72.1%). Root cause: slurry contamination in CMP brush or localized chamber wall flaking in ETCH_01. Particle count excursion: 1946/m³ (threshold: 1000/m³). Slurry batch SB_2025_003 may be contaminated. Equipment: clean cycle 95, 190 hours since PM (overdue for maintenance).

Systematic grid defect pattern with regular spacing (43 die failures, yield 89.5%). Grid spacing approximately 4-5 dies. Root cause: RF power drift of +126W from nominal setpoint causing periodic plasma instability in CMP_TOOL_02. RF power measured at 1847W (nominal: 1721W). This drift creates systematic non-uniformity in etch/deposition rate across the wafer. Equipment context: recipe RECIPE_14, 163 hours since PM. Recommend RF generator recalibration and matching network tuning.

Edge Top defect pattern with 56 die failures (yield 86.3%). Edge defects concentrated on top side. Root cause: temperature gradient of -10.9°C toward top due to RF coil positioning in ETCH_01. Supporting evidence: chamber temperature 69.5°C, RF power 1739W. Equipment context: recipe RECIPE_04, slurry batch SB_2025_093, clean cycle 96 (136 hours since PM). Spatial analysis shows strong directional bias with defects decreasing toward opposite edge.

Edge Bottom defect pattern with 62 die failures (yield 84.8%). Edge defects concentrated on bottom side. Root cause: temperature gradient of -11.4°C toward bottom due to RF coil positioning in ETCH_01. Supporting evidence: chamber temperature 68.0°C, RF power 1797W. Equipment context: recipe RECIPE_07, slurry batch SB_2025_073, clean cycle 107 (173 hours since PM). Spatial analysis shows strong directional bias with defects decreasing toward opposite edge.

Systematic grid defect pattern with regular spacing (10 die failures, yield 97.5%). Grid spacing approximately 4-5 dies, suggesting reticle-level defect. Root cause: reticle particulate contamination on lithography mask or stepper field stitching error in LITHO_01. Alternative: RF power drift (+155W) causing periodic plasma instability. Equipment context: recipe RECIPE_11, RF power 1885W. Recommend reticle inspection and cleaning.
